policy.purpose: Permit stronger support labels only after proposition-level review against the exact official provision.
policy.textual_rule: TEXTUAL requires the external provision to materially state the same proposition without relying on unstated extensions.
policy.derived_rule: DERIVED requires an explicit, reviewable reasoning bridge from the external legal proposition to the Conductellence rule; the extension must be stated.
policy.applicability_rule: Neither TEXTUAL nor DERIVED determines legal applicability. Applicability is resolved separately.
